build_logistic_regression_jags_model: build a JAGS logistic regression model by instantiating LogisticRegression with hyperparameter attrs
run_format_data_to_jags: run format_data_to_jags on an xarray Dataset to produce a JAGS-ready data dictionary with X and Y
run_extract_data_from_jags: run extract_data_from_jags on a JAGS samples dict to get an xarray Dataset of alpha and beta draws
run_get_code: run get_code to retrieve the JAGS model code string with priors and likelihood for logistic regression
run_get_vars: run get_vars to retrieve the list of model variables alpha and beta needed from inference
